scheme_name: FOCUS (Farmers’ Collectivization for Upscaling Production and Marketing System)
description: Meghalaya's flagship flagship farmer support program designed to organize small and marginal farmers into Producer Groups (PGs) and provide seed capital to scale up farming, processing, and direct market access.
benefits: Direct seed capital grant of ₹5,000 per member (up to ₹1,00,000 per Producer Group) deposited into the group's bank account for agri-business operations.
eligibility: Farmers residing in Meghalaya organized into registered Producer Groups (10 to 20 members)
Must be registered on the Meghviman / FOCUS portal
documents: Aadhaar Card Copy of all members
Joint Bank Account Details of the Producer Group
application_mode: Online via FOCUS Portal (focus.mbda.gov.in) / Offline through District BDO Office

category: GI Tag Crop Promotion & Value Addition
description: Dedicated mission to expand cultivation, quality processing, and export of the world-famous high-curcumin Lakadong Turmeric grown primarily in the Jaintia Hills region.
benefits: Free distribution of high-yielding Lakadong turmeric seed rhizomes, 75% subsidy on solar turmeric driers and washing equipment, and direct market buyback linkages.
eligibility: Traditional and new turmeric growers, SHGs, and Producer Groups in West & East Jaintia Hills and surrounding notified districts
documents: Land Possession Certificate or Headman Certificate
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / MBDA Offices

description: Aims to increase ginger yield, eliminate disease in seed ginger, and build processing facilities to produce ginger powder, oil, and candy for export.
benefits: Subsidized disease-free organic seed ginger, 50% subsidy on ginger processing and washing machines, and free organic certification.
eligibility: Farmers and farmer cooperatives in major ginger-growing districts like Ri-Bhoi, West Garo Hills, and East Khasi Hills
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / MBDA Office

description: A major initiative funded in partnership with NCDC to achieve self-sufficiency in pork production by supporting commercial pig breeding, fattening, and processing units.
benefits: Interest-free / highly subsidized loans, up to 50% capital grant for establishing 3-sow or 10-sow pig breeding units, plus free pig insurance and vaccination.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Meghalaya, Cooperative Societies, Producer Groups, and individual livestock farmers
documents: Land Availability Proof or Headman Certificate for Pig Shed
application_mode: Offline via District AH & Veterinary Officer / Meghalaya Livestock Enterprises Federation

description: Promotes commercial mushroom farming (Oyster, Button, Shiitake) to augment farm incomes, combat malnutrition, and create year-round employment.
benefits: 75% subsidy on mushroom spawn production units, substrate preparation units, and climate-controlled mushroom cultivation sheds.
eligibility: Smallholders, landless laborers, women SHGs, and rural youth residing in Meghalaya
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer / Mushroom Development Center Shillong

description: Supports scientific apiculture to produce pure forest and wildflower honey, boosting crop pollination and generating supplementary rural livelihoods.
benefits: 80% subsidy on scientific bee boxes, colonies, honey extraction equipment, and free technical training provided by the Commerce & Industries / Agriculture Dept.
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural youth, and SHGs residing in Meghalaya
application_mode: Offline via District Commerce & Industries Centre (DCIC) / District Horticulture Office

description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, power weeders, mini-tractors, and brush cutters tailored for Meghalaya's hilly terrace topography.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual tribal farmers and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) by Producer Groups.
eligibility: Farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land in Meghalaya, SHGs, and registered Producer Groups
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Officer (DAO)

scheme_name: Meghalaya Integrated Aquaculture Development Project (Fish Mission)
description: Promotes fish farming in individual and community ponds, high-altitude trout culture, and paddy-cum-fish culture to meet regional fish demand.
benefits: 60% to 75% capital subsidy for excavating new fish ponds, fingerlings, fish feed, and water quality testing kits.
eligibility: Landowners, farmer groups, and unemployed youth in Meghalaya with suitable land and water sources
documents: Land Possession Certificate / Village Headman NOC
Site Inspection Report by Fisheries Officer
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO)

description: Encourages off-season vegetable growing (capsicum, tomato, cucumber) and cut flowers (carnations, gerbera) under polyhouses and shade-net structures.
benefits: 50% to 70% capital grant for installing tubular polyhouse structures, drip irrigation systems, and high-yielding seeds.
eligibility: Horticulture farmers and Producer Groups in Meghalaya with permanent water and land access
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / MBDA

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Water Pumping Scheme (Meghalaya Component)
description: Installs standalone solar-powered pumpsets in off-grid hilly agricultural areas to ensure reliable irrigation for high-value horticulture crops.
benefits: Up to 85% total subsidy (combined central and state funds) on standalone solar pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Meghalaya with access to surface water or open wells lacking grid power
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing Electric Pump Connection
application_mode: Offline via MNREDA (Meghalaya Non-Conventional and Rural Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office
